example.translationZh: 她努力学习以通过大学入学考试。

example.translationZh: 她恳求老师再给她一次机会。

definitionEn: n. an item inserted in a written record\nn. a written record of a commercial transaction

example.translationZh: 你需要有效的入境签证才能前往那个国家。

example.translationZh: 这项新法律旨在加强沿海地区的环境保护。

example.translationZh: 规划者设想了一种情形：这座城市将在十年内把绿地面积扩大一倍。

definitionEn:

example.translationZh: 当她看到同事的新晋升时，她非常嫉妒。

example.translationZh: 这种酶有助于在胃里分解蛋白质。

example.translationZh: 樱花是一种短暂的美，每年春天只持续几天。

definitionEn: n. a happening that is distinctive in a series of related events\nn. a brief section of a literary or dramatic work that forms part of a connected series\nn. a part of a broadcast serial

example.translationZh: 我迫不及待想今晚看这部剧的最后一集。

definitionEn: n. (astronomy) an arbitrarily fixed date that is the point in time relative to which information (as coordinates of a celestial body) is recorded\nn. a unit of geological time that is a subdivision of a period and is itself divided into ages
definitionZh: n. 新纪元, 时代, 时期

example.text: The invention of the internet marked a new epoch in human communication.
example.translationZh: 互联网的发明标志着人类交流的新纪元。

definitionEn:
v. be identical or equivalent to
v. be equal to in quality or ability

vt. 等于, 比得上
[计] 等长度编码

example.text: Everyone should have equal rights under the law.
example.translationZh: 每个人在法律面前都应享有平等的权利。

definitionEn: n. a mathematical statement that two expressions are equal\nn. the act of regarding as equal
definitionZh: n. 相等, 等式, 平衡\n[化] 方程式; 等式; 反应式; 公式

example.translationZh: 学生们学会了如何解一个含有两个变量的方程。

example.text: The ship crossed the equator at dawn, and the sailors celebrated with a traditional ceremony.

definitionEn: n. a stable situation in which forces cancel one another\nn. a sensory system located in structures of the inner ear that registers the orientation of the head
definitionZh: n. 平衡, 平静, 均衡\n[化] 平衡

example.text: After the earthquake, the market slowly reached a new equilibrium.
example.translationZh: 地震之后，市场慢慢达到了新的平衡。

definitionEn: n. an instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service
definitionZh: n. 装备, 设备, 才能\n[化] 设备; 装备; 装置

example.translationZh: 实验室为化学系购买了新设备。

definitionEn: a. fair to all parties as dictated by reason and conscience
definitionZh: a. 公平的, 公正的\n[法] 公平的, 公正的, 平衡法的

example.text: The new policy aims to ensure an equitable distribution of resources among all communities.
example.translationZh: 这项新政策旨在确保资源在所有社区之间得到公平分配。

definitionEn: n. the difference between the market value of a property and the claims held against it\nn. the ownership interest of shareholders in a corporation
definitionZh: n. 公平, 公正\n[经] 权益, 产权

example.translationZh: 公司进行了一项审查，以确保所有部门之间的薪酬公平。

definitionEn: a. open to two or more interpretations; or of uncertain nature or significance; or (often) intended to mislead\ns. open to question\ns. uncertain as a sign or indication

example.text: When asked whether he would support the new policy, the mayor gave an equivocal answer that pleased neither side.
example.translationZh: 当被问及是否会支持这项新政策时，市长给出了一个模棱两可的回答，双方都不满意。

definitionEn: v kill in large numbers\nv destroy completely, as if down to the roots
definitionZh: vt. 根除, 扑灭, 根绝, 消灭

example.translationZh: 政府承诺在十年内消除农村地区的贫困。

definitionEn: v. remove from memory or existence\nv. remove by or as if by rubbing or erasing\nv. wipe out digitally or magnetically recorded information

example.text: Please erase the mistakes on this page before you hand in the worksheet.
example.translationZh: 交练习纸之前，请把这一页上的错误擦掉。

definitionEn: a. upright in position or posture

example.translationZh: 士兵们在整场仪式中笔直站立。

definitionZh: n. 腐蚀, 冲蚀, 侵蚀\n[化] 磨耗; 侵蚀

example.translationZh: 暴雨会加速山坡上的土壤侵蚀。

example.translationZh: 你能帮我去趟邮局取包裹吗？

example.translationZh: 多变的天气使得计划户外活动变得困难。

example.translationZh: 这份报告是基于对材料成本的错误假设而写成的。

example.translationZh: 火山随时可能喷发。

example.translationZh: 两国互相指责对方试图让边境冲突升级。

definitionEn: n. a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt
definitionZh: n. 电动扶梯, 自动扶梯\n[机] 升降阶梯

example.text: She took the escalator to the second floor because the elevator was out of order.
example.translationZh: 因为电梯坏了，她乘自动扶梯上了二楼。

definitionEn: n. the act of accompanying someone or something in order to protect them\nn. an attendant who is employed to accompany someone\nv. accompany as an escort
definitionZh: n. 护送者, 护卫者, 护航舰\nvt. 护卫, 护送

example.translationZh: 这名证人由警察护送至法院。

example.translationZh: 她必须为学校比赛写一篇关于家乡的文章。

definitionZh: n. 实质, 本质, 香精\n[化] 香精

example.translationZh: 这个论点的本质是我们需要更多时间。

example.translationZh: 她因敬业而深受同事们的尊敬。

definitionZh: a. 永恒的, 永远的, 不灭的

example.translationZh: 古埃及人相信死后有永恒的生命。

definitionEn: n. rules governing socially acceptable behavior
definitionZh: n. 礼仪, 礼节, 成规\n[法] 规则, 成规, 礼节

example.text: She always follows proper professional etiquette when meeting new clients.
example.translationZh: 她在会见新客户时总是遵循得体的职业礼仪。

example.translationZh: 她是一个在欧洲生活多年但居住在亚洲的欧洲人。

example.translationZh: 火警响了，所以员工们不得不立即疏散出大楼。

example.translationZh: 这家公司试图把事故责任推给分包商来逃避责任。

example.translationZh: 在意外医疗费用之后，他们的积蓄似乎消失得无影无踪。

example.translationZh: 这张旧照片唤起了她对海边童年夏天的回忆。

example.translationZh: 进化论解释了物种如何随时间而变化。

example.translationZh: 削减公共交通资金只会使交通拥堵问题进一步恶化。

example.translationZh: 航空公司对托运行李收取额外费用。

definitionEn: s. recklessly wasteful
definitionZh: a. 奢侈的, 挥霍无度的, 浪费的

example.text: They lived an extravagant lifestyle, spending money on designer clothes and luxury cars.
example.translationZh: 他们过着奢侈的生活，把钱花在名牌服装和豪车上。

definitionEn:
n. the furthest or highest degree of something
s. of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
s. far beyond a norm in quantity or amount or degree; to an utmost degree
s. beyond a norm in views or actions
definitionZh: n. 极端, 末端\na. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的

example.text: The region experienced extreme weather last summer, with record heat and sudden storms.
example.translationZh: 去年夏天该地区经历了极端天气，出现了创纪录的高温和突如其来的暴风雨。

definitionEn: s. produced or growing in extreme abundance
definitionZh: a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的\n[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的

example.text: After the spring rains, the garden was filled with exuberant growth.
example.translationZh: 春雨过后，花园里长满了茂盛的植物。

phrase.translationZh: 茂盛的 growth；旺盛的生长

definitionEn:
n. the organ of sight
n. good discernment (either visually or as if visually)
n. attention to what is seen
n. a small hole or loop (as in a needle)
definitionZh: n. 眼睛, 视力, 看\nvt. 看, 注视

example.text: Please keep an eye on my bag while I buy a ticket.
example.translationZh: 我去买票的时候，请帮我看一下包。

definitionEn: n. normal use of the faculty of vision
definitionZh: n. 视力, 目力

example.text: Owls have very good eyesight for hunting at night.
example.translationZh: 猫头鹰的视力非常好，适合在夜间捕猎。

definitionEn: n. artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
definitionZh: n. 织物, 布, 结构, 构造, 建筑物\n[经] 组织, 建筑物, 工厂

example.text: The dress is made of a soft cotton fabric.
example.translationZh: 这条裙子是用柔软的棉织物做的。

definitionEn: v. make up something artificial or untrue
definitionZh: vt. 制造, 建造, 装配, 伪造

example.text: The investigators discovered that the accountant had tried to fabricate evidence to hide the missing funds.
example.translationZh: 调查人员发现，那名会计试图伪造证据来掩盖失踪的资金。
